title: A notebook demonstrating the Handoff pattern for the core library
body:
### What feature would you like to be added?

OpenAI introduces the handoff pattern for orchestrating multiple agents. We can demonstrate how to implement this using pub/sub. The notebook should live under the multi agent design patterns section in the core user guide. 

See: https://github.com/openai/openai-cookbook/blob/main/examples/Orchestrating_agents.ipynb

And https://github.com/openai/swarm

### Why is this needed?

Handoff pattern can be useful for tasks that requires incremental decomposition. It is an alternative to group chat.
